description: This is a PHP class definition for the EmailMan module in SuiteCRM, handling email campaign logic, email creation, verification, sending, and related operations.

classes.name: EmailMan
classes.description: Represents the email campaign entity, with methods for creating, verifying, sending, and managing email campaigns and related data.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the EmailMan object with key properties.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL query to retrieve a list of email campaigns based on filters and ordering.

methods.name: create_queue_items_query
methods.description: Constructs a SQL query for retrieving queued email campaign items.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Creates a SQL query to list email campaign records with specific filters.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Fetches and formats data for display in the list view, including recipient names and emails.

methods.name: set_as_sent
methods.description: Marks an email as sent, deletes it from the emailman table, and logs campaign activity.

methods.name: create_ref_email
methods.description: Creates a reference email for a campaign, generating email records and relationships.

methods.name: create_indiv_email
methods.description: Creates an individual email record for a user or contact, including attachment handling.

methods.name: verify_campaign
methods.description: Checks the existence and integrity of the email marketing campaign and email template.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Handles the process of sending an email through the SMTP system, including template parsing, tracking, and logging.

methods.name: valid_email_address
methods.description: Validates the format of an email address using a regex pattern.

methods.name: is_primary_email_address
methods.description: Checks if the given bean has a primary email address.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL query to export email campaign data.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Deletes an email campaign record from the database.

methods.name: getLastOptInWarn
methods.description: Returns whether the last opt-in warning was triggered.

methods.name: addOptInEmailToEmailQueue
methods.description: Adds an opt-in email to the queue if configured and appropriate.

methods.name: sendOptInEmail
methods.description: Sends an opt-in email via the SMTP system.

methods.name: sendOptInEmailViaMailer
methods.description: Constructs and dispatches the opt-in email using SugarPHPMailer.

methods.name: shouldBlockEmail
methods.description: Determines whether sending an email to a bean should be blocked based on opt-in, opt-out, or invalid status.

methods.name: getTargetId
methods.description: Returns the current target ID used for tracking.

methods.name: setTargetId
methods.description: Sets the tracking target ID.
